detailZh: 意大利大奖赛：法拉利在首次蒙扎练习赛中揭晓新升级后包揽前二，夏尔·勒克莱尔领先刘易斯·汉密尔顿
首次练习赛中，勒克莱尔领衔法拉利一二名完赛，领先汉密尔顿；法拉利在主场赛事揭晓最新升级后表现令人印象深刻；意大利大奖赛周五第二次练习赛将于下午3点举行，天空体育 F1现场直播；排位赛于周六下午3点进行
天空体育的Ted Kravitz深入解析法拉利的重大升级，他们在蒙扎的意大利大奖赛主场全力以赴。
在意大利大奖赛第一次自由练习中，夏尔·勒克莱尔领先队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿，帮助法拉利包揽前二，法拉利在蒙扎首次亮相升级版引擎后表现出色。
勒克莱尔的成绩为1分23.008秒，比汉密尔顿快0.173秒，梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔再落后十分之一秒，排名第三。
世界锦标赛领跑者基米·安东内利排名第五，他因本赛季使用引擎部件超出配额，周日的比赛将从发车区末位起步。

迈凯伦车队的 诺里斯 已连赢最近两场比赛，重新点燃了他卫冕车手总冠军的希望，目前他以第六名排在 Antonelli 之后。
安东内利（Antonelli）以领先59分的优势在积分榜榜首超越拉塞尔（Russell）和汉密尔顿（Hamilton），诺里斯（Norris）落后这位意大利车手83分，位居第四。
在意大利大奖赛一练期间，角田裕毅（角田裕毅）在车队电台中愤怒抱怨，因为他追上了不断变线的保罗·阿隆（Paul Aron）驾驶的阿尔派赛车。
法拉利选择在主场分站启用本赛季获准使用的两个引擎升级中的第二个，此前国际汽联的测量结果显示他们的动力单元不如红牛和梅赛德斯生产的产品。
法拉利还为蒙扎带来了针对该赛道的一套底盘升级，试图提升赛车在这条高速赛道的性能。
他们本周末的首秀之所以更加令人印象深刻，是因为勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿的最快成绩都是在中性胎上做出的，而拉塞尔的最快单圈则是在理论上更快的软胎上完成的。
然而，由于安东内利知道单圈速度对他来说并不重要，因为无论排位成绩如何他都将从队尾发车，所以梅赛德斯很可能拥有比他们所展示出的更快的速度。
刘维斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）驾驶着一辆罕见的法拉利F40抵达意大利大奖赛，并透露这辆车的发动机编号与他的赛车号码相同。
利亚姆·劳森（劳森）为红牛车队取得了令人鼓舞的第四名，该车队的参赛阵容中并不包括他们任何一位官方的2026年车手。
劳森代替伊萨克·哈贾尔（哈贾尔）出战，后者在夏休期期间手腕受伤，将缺席第二场比赛，而维斯塔潘则是为让新秀参加本次练习赛而让位的四位车手之一。
岩佐步梦（Ayumu Iwasa）驾驶维斯塔潘的红牛赛车排名第17位，而保罗·阿隆（Paul Aron）以第10名成为阿尔派车队表现最好的新秀。
科尔顿·赫塔（Colton Herta）为凯迪拉克出战的机会因技术问题而提前结束，英国的卢克·布朗宁（Luke Browning）为威廉姆斯车队获得第15名。

detailEn: Italian GP: Charles Leclerc leads Lewis Hamilton as Ferrari seal one-two in first Monza practice after revealing upgrades

Charles Leclerc leads Ferrari one-two from Lewis Hamilton in first practice; Ferrari impress after unveiling latest upgrades for home race; watch Friday's second practice session for the Italian GP at 3pm, live on Sky Sports F1; Qualifying is at 3pm on Saturday
Sky Sports' Ted Kravitz takes a closer look at Ferrari’s major upgrades as they go all-in for their home Italian Grand Prix at Monza.
Charles Leclerc led a one-two from team-mate Lewis Hamilton in Italian Grand Prix first practice as Ferrari impressed after debuting an engine upgrade at Monza.
Leclerc's time of 1:23.008s put him 0.173s clear of Hamilton, with Mercedes' George Russell a further tenth back in third.
World championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who will start from the back of the grid in Sunday's race after exceeding his allowance of engine parts for the season, was fifth for Mercedes.

McLaren's Lando Norris, who has won the last two races to reignite his hopes of defending his title, was behind Antonelli in sixth.
Antonelli leads both Russell and Hamilton by 59 points at the top of the standings, with Norris 83 points behind the Italian in fourth.
Tempers flare during Practice 1 at the Italian GP as Yuki Tsunoda rages over team radio as he comes up behind the weaving Alpine of Paul Aron.

Ferrari have chosen their home race to deploy the second of the two engine upgrades they've been permitted to use across the season, after the FIA's measurements found their power unit to be inferior to those produced by Red Bull and Mercedes.
Ferrari have also brought a package of circuit-specific chassis upgrades to Monza in an attempt to boost the performance of the car at the high-speed track.

Their first showing of the weekend was made more impressive by the fact that the best times from Leclerc and Hamilton were both performed on the medium compound, while Russell's best lap was on the theoretically faster soft tyre.

However, with Antonelli knowing one-lap pace isn't important for him as he will start from the back of the grid regardless of where he qualifies, it's possible Mercedes have more speed than they showed.
Lewis Hamilton arrived at the Italian GP in a rare Ferrari F40 and revealed that the car's engine bore the same number as his racing number.
Liam Lawson took an encouraging fourth for a Red Bull team fielding a line-up that included neither of their official 2026 drivers.

Lawson was driving in place of Isack Hadjar, who is missing a second race after injuring his wrist over the sport's summer break, while Verstappen was one of four drivers to make way for rookies to feature in the session.
Ayumu Iwasa was 17th in Verstappen's Red Bull, while Paul Aron was the best-performing rookie in 10th for Alpine.
Colton Herta's chance to drive for Cadillac was cut short by a technical issue, and Britain's Luke Browning was 15th for Williams.

detailEn: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton fastest from Max Verstappen in final practice ahead of Qualifying in Austin

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton outpaced Red Bull's Max Verstappen in final practice in Austin with Friday's pace-setter Charles Leclerc in third; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Lewis Hamilton claims the fastest lap from Max Verstappen in final practice at the United States Grand Prix
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice from Max Verstappen at the United States Grand Prix to set up a tantalising qualifying in Austin.
Hamilton was 0.168s quicker than Verstappen as Ferrari and Red Bull look set to fight for pole position and victory for a second consecutive weekend.
Charles Leclerc topped both of Friday's sessions and had set the quickest time in final practice by one tenth from Hamilton, only for it to be deleted due to track limits.

Track limits is set to be a major issue for the drivers in qualifying, which takes place at 10pm UK time later on Saturday (build-up from 8.30pm live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event) due to the tarmac run-off areas and the drivers keen to use every bit of track to gain lap time.

Leclerc still finished the session in third, ahead of championship leader Kimi Antonelli whose chances of becoming the youngest world champion look extremely difficult, given he must first win the Grand Prix to give himself an opportunity, and Mercedes are a tad off the pace.
Antonelli was three tenths behind Hamilton's pace-setting time with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in fifth at nearly half a second down.

McLaren's Lando Norris was eighth but would have been in the top five had his best lap not been deleted for track limit, while Oscar Piastri was sixth and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg impressing in seventh.
